vocabulary.scenario: CTID APT29 adversary-emulation-inspired identity and cloud detection validation
vocabulary.notice: These are benign, pre-registered telemetry fixtures. They do not register devices, alter OAuth applications, authenticate, or contact a cloud service.

fixtures.name: Simulated Entra device registration
fixtures.expected_detection: Alert or investigation for a new device registration on a protected test account.
fixtures.rule_guidance: Correlate device registration with identity risk, new location, and privileged-account context.

fixtures.name: Simulated OAuth application credential addition
fixtures.expected_detection: Alert or investigation for an application credential addition or permission escalation.
fixtures.rule_guidance: Monitor application credential additions, consent, and high-risk permission changes.

fixtures.name: Simulated suspicious cloud sign-in pattern
fixtures.expected_detection: Alert or investigation for a test-account sign-in risk pattern.
fixtures.rule_guidance: Correlate unusual location, dormant account, risk state, and sensitive follow-on activity.

fixtures.name: Simulated encoded PowerShell detection
fixtures.expected_detection: Alert or investigation for an encoded PowerShell indicator on a test endpoint.
fixtures.rule_guidance: Alert on encoded-command indicators with parent-process and user context; validate false positives in the lab.
